answer: Because the echo fee is applied at the pearl exit, the delta audit totals the burn and the ledger shows exactly what left. Withdrawing stake burns a 1% fee that is burned rather than redistributed, so moving capital between aliases destroys a slice of it every time. An operator rotating funds across many keys thus bleeds value on each hop, which is a cost an agent that leaves its stake in place never pays. Each copy needs 5 hours of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
